dedupe_keys.name: date climatologice de la cele 23 de statii esentiale flux rbsn

description: Date climatologice de la cele 23 de statii esentiale (flux RBSN) is a dataset listed in data.gov.ro, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administrația Națională de Meteorologie. Climatological data from the 23 critical stations (BSN flow: 15015-Ocna Sugatag, 15020-Botosani, 15090-Iasi, 15108-Ceahlau Toaca, 15120-Cluj-Napoca, 15150-Bacau, 15170-Miercurea Ciuc, 15200-Arad, 15230-Deva, 15260-Sibiu, 15280-Varfu Omu, 15292-Caransebeș, 15310-Galati, 15335-Tulcea, 15346-Râmnicu Valcea, 15350-Buzau, 15360-Sulina, 15410-Drobeta Turnu Severin, 15420-Bucuresti-Băneasa, 15450-Craiova, 15460-Călărarași, 15470-Rosiorii de Vede, 15480-Constanta) which include the minimum daily temperature, the maximum daily temperature, the average daily temperature ... Coverage: Administrația Națională de Meteorologie. The portal shows the English title as "Climatological data from 23 critical stations (BSN flow)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administrația Națională de Meteorologie. Its keywords include climatologie. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2018-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ro.
